name: bullmq
description: Background jobs with BullMQ: a demo queue, a separate worker process, and enqueue/status endpoints (needs Redis).
env: # bullmq uses REDIS_URL or the individual Redis settings defined above
instructions: Ensure Redis is running:  docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d
Run the worker in a separate terminal:  {{apiRun}} dev:worker{{apiWorkspaceArg}}
Enqueue a job:  curl -XPOST localhost:5002/jobs -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"text":"hello"}'
Check status:   curl localhost:5002/jobs/<id>  (state goes waiting -> active -> completed)
Deploy the worker as its own process: k3s manifest added at infra/k3s/worker-deployment.yaml; Docker Compose example at infra/docker/worker.compose.example.yml
